title: Verify that publishing the fully authored page renders every active component in configured order to an anonymous visitor
description: Site Content Editor publishes QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch authored with 4 quick facts (order 1-4), 3 sections (order 1-3), 3 Overview info cards (order 1-3), 2 information groups (order 1-2) with 6 and 4 bullets, and 2 resource items (order 1-2), all Active in both EN and AR.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor and open the QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch record in Object Authoring
Click Publish
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a FRESH logged-out browser context
Read the page top to bottom and record the order of the quick facts, sections, info cards, information groups and resource items
expected_list: The record opens with page status Draft and all components Active
The record status changes to Published and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The public page returns HTTP 200 for an anonymous visitor with no login prompt

The content renders in configured display order: quick facts 'Proposal Type', 'Research Focus', 'Primary Audience', 'Responsible Department'; sections '01 Overview', '02 Service information', '03 Downloadable resources'; info cards 'Clear research focus', 'Business guidance', 'Contact our experts'; groups 'Preparing your proposal' (6 bullets) then 'Supporting information' (4 bullets); resources 'Research Proposal Template' then 'Research Proposal Guidelines'

title: Verify that an anonymous visitor can download the Research Proposal Template document from the published page
description: Published page; resource item 'Research Proposal Template' Active with a 200 KB PDF named QCTEST-130949-template.pdf attached.
steps_list: Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a fresh logged-out browser context and scroll to section 03
Click the 'Download' button on the 'Research Proposal Template' card
Inspect the downloaded file
expected_list: The 'Research Proposal Template' card renders with the metadata 'PDF' and '200 KB' and an enabled 'Download' button
The download starts without any login prompt or intermediate form and returns HTTP 200
The downloaded file is QCTEST-130949-template.pdf, opens as a valid PDF and is approximately 200 KB — matching the file size shown on the card

title: Verify that a page saved as Draft is not reachable by an anonymous visitor
description: Site Content Editor sets QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch to Draft after it was previously Published, with all components still Active.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor, open the record in Object Authoring, set the page status to Draft and Save as Draft
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a FRESH logged-out browser context with no CMS session
Search the site for the phrase 'Proposal for Research' as an anonymous visitor
expected_list: The record is saved with status Draft and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed

The anonymous request does not render the page content: no hero title 'Proposal for Research', no quick facts and no resource cards are returned; the visitor gets the site's not-found or unauthorised response instead
The draft page does not appear in the anonymous search results

title: Verify that unpublishing the page removes it from public view while the content is retained in the CMS
description: Published page QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch with all components Active.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor, open the record in Object Authoring and click Unpublish
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a FRESH logged-out browser context
Re-open the record in Object Authoring and inspect the hero, quick facts, sections, groups and resource items
expected_list: The record status changes to Unpublished and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The anonymous request does not render the page: no hero title, no sections and no Download buttons are returned

All authored content is retained: the hero still reads 'Proposal for Research' / 'اقتراح بحث أو دراسة', all 4 quick facts, 3 sections, 3 info cards, 2 groups with 10 bullets and 2 resource items with their attached PDFs are still present in the record

title: Verify that a downloadable document can be replaced without unpublishing the page and its file type and size are re-captured
description: Published page; resource item 'Research Proposal Template' currently holds QCTEST-130949-template.pdf (200 KB). Replacement file: QCTEST-130949-template-v2.pdf (1.2 MB PDF).
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor and open the QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch record in Object Authoring WITHOUT unpublishing the page
Replace the file on the 'Research Proposal Template' resource item with QCTEST-130949-template-v2.pdf and save
Read the record's page status
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a FRESH logged-out browser context, read the first resource card's metadata and click its 'Download' button
expected_list: The record opens for editing while its status remains Published; no unpublish step is required to reach the file field
The file is accepted and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The page status is still Published — it was never set to Draft or Unpublished during the replacement
The card still reads title 'Research Proposal Template' with file type 'PDF' and now shows the re-captured size '1.2 MB' instead of '200 KB', and the download returns QCTEST-130949-template-v2.pdf

title: Verify that unpublished changes are visible in Preview only and never on the live public page
description: Published page. Pending edit: the Overview heading changed from 'Overview' to 'QCTEST-130949 Overview Preview' and left unpublished.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor, open the record in Object Authoring and change the Overview section title to 'QCTEST-130949 Overview Preview'
Click Save as Draft, then click Preview and read the Overview section heading in the preview
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a FRESH logged-out browser context and read the Overview section heading and the sticky index
expected_list: The field accepts the new section title
The preview renders the Overview section heading as 'QCTEST-130949 Overview Preview'
The live public page still renders the heading 'Overview' and the sticky index entry '01 Overview'; the preview-only value 'QCTEST-130949 Overview Preview' appears nowhere in the anonymous response
